title: Connells Group reports £500,000 loss in first half of 2026
summary:
Connells Group recorded a loss of £500,000 during the first six months of 2026, a significant reversal from the £28.4 million profit reported in the same period last year. The estate agency group, owned by Skipton Building Society, attributed the loss to subdued market conditions and ongoing restructuring costs.

title: Rightmove faces £2.3m legal costs over competition claim
summary:
Rightmove has disclosed that it expects to incur £2.3 million in legal costs this year relating to a class action lawsuit alleging anti-competitive behaviour. The property portal's operating costs increased by 17% to £77.7 million as it prepares to defend the £1.5 billion claim at a November tribunal hearing.

title: Rightmove reports 7% revenue growth with AI expansion
summary:
Property portal Rightmove has reported a 7% year-on-year revenue increase to £225.8 million for the first half of 2026. The company has deployed 46 strategic AI initiatives, with its AI-enabled valuation tool contributing to a 50% increase in unique leads to estate agents.

title: London property transactions take six months to complete
summary:
Property transactions in London take an average of 174 days from agreed sale to completion, making it the slowest region in Britain, according to Rightmove analysis. The data reveals significant regional variations, with Scotland completing transactions in 98 days on average and the North East of England recording the fastest times in England.

title: UK property transactions now take 216 days to complete
summary:
Estate agents in Great Britain are experiencing the longest wait on record to receive commission payments, as the average home sale now takes 216 days from listing to completion. The property portal's data shows completion times have increased by 36 days since 2019 despite technological advances.

title: UK housing market shows signs of stabilisation in July
summary:
The UK housing market showed signs of stabilisation in July, with the annual gap in agreed sales narrowing to 5.2% after running 10% behind 2025 levels since Easter. Scotland was the only region to record annual growth, whilst London remained the weakest performer.

title: Cheshire mortgage fraudster sentenced for £200,000 scam
summary:
A man who posed as a mortgage adviser and defrauded four people of more than £200,000 has been sentenced at Chester Crown Court. Adam Francis received a suspended sentence after pleading guilty to four counts of fraud by false representation.

title: First-time buyers face rising mortgage costs and deposits
summary:
First-time buyers are encountering increased financial pressure from rising mortgage rates and deposit requirements, according to analysis from Moneyfacts. The average new mortgage rate now stands at 5.59%, up from 4.90% in March, with low deposit buyers facing rates above 6%.

title: Bank of England holds rates at 3.75% as inflation concerns persist
summary:
The Bank of England has held interest rates at 3.75% for the fifth consecutive meeting, with three policymakers voting for an increase. Governor Andrew Bailey warned that inflation could rise later this year due to ongoing Middle East tensions affecting energy prices.

title: Specialist lender approves holiday let in Oxfordshire
summary:
A specialist mortgage lender has completed financing for a holiday let property in Burford, Oxfordshire, demonstrating the niche lending criteria required for properties with occupancy restrictions and non-standard characteristics. Foundation Home Loans provided a mortgage of £153,700 for the purchase of a £205,000 freehold property within a six-unit development.
